fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: **New Delhi:** India has achieved a significant breakthrough in the field of aerospace and defence technology with the successful development of the country’s **first indigenous Expendable Turbo Jet Engine in the 350 kg thrust class**. On **July 22, 2026**, Azad Engineering successfully realised and delivered the indigenous turbo jet engine to GTRE, marking a landmark achievement for India’s aerospace and defence ecosystem. The successful delivery of this sophisticated engine, based on **DRDO’s indigenous design**, highlights the growing technological capabilities of India’s defence industry and strengthens the country’s journey towards self-reliance in critical defence technologies. **Defence Secretary, Secretary of Department of Defence R&D and Chairman, DRDO Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh** congratulated the GTRE–industry partnership, stating that the collaboration has played a crucial role in converting a technological vision into a historic milestone for India’s defence manufacturing sector. The achievement is expected to further strengthen India’s indigenous aerospace capabilities and support the development of advanced defence systems in the future.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Ha-Meem Group, Robonauts partner to accelerate smart manufacturing in RMG sector - The Business Standard
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Ha-Meem Group, Robonauts partner to accelerate smart manufacturing in RMG sector. **Ha-Meem Group today (18 July) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Robonauts Ltd. to accelerate the adoption of Industry 4.0 technologies and develop a future-ready workforce for Bangladesh's ready-made garment (RMG) sector.**. The partnership aims to combine Ha-Meem Group's manufacturing expertise with Robonauts' capabilities in robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), industrial automation and engineering education to strengthen the competitiveness of the country's apparel industry. COO of Robonauts Md Moonzoor Morshed said the partnership will also support the adoption of robotics, AI, machine vision, intelligent sensors and other smart manufacturing technologies across Ha-Meem Group's operations. The companies said the partnership marks the beginning of a long-term collaboration to promote innovation, knowledge sharing and sustainable industrial growth, while supporting Bangladesh's ambition to remain a global leader in intelligent and technology-driven apparel manufacturing. Robonauts Ltd. also expressed its heartfelt gratitude to Mr Sajid Azad, Director of Ha-Meem Group, for his vision, encouragement and valuable support in making the collaboration possible.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Center City Philadelphia dental office reopens after license suspension - 6abc Philadelphia
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # Center City Philadelphia dental office reopens after license suspension. Dental office in Center City to reopen after license suspension. PHILADELPHIA (WPVI) -- A Center City dental office is set to reopen after its owner's license was temporarily suspended following an investigation into infection-control practices that health officials said put patients at risk for HIV and hepatitis C. Dr. Kirti Chopra, owner of the practice formerly known as Smiles at Rittenhouse Square and now operating as Smiles at The Square, said the experience has been difficult and has prompted changes at the office. The practice, located on the 25th floor of a Center City building, has remained closed since May, when Chopra's license was temporarily suspended after a surprise inspection. The Philadelphia Department of Public Health said it is not aware of any cases of either disease associated with the office. In a statement, the department said, "The recommendations that PDPH made to ensure patient safety have been satisfactorily implemented, and we are not opposed to the practice reopening, subject to continued compliance with their agreement with the state.".

Lalit Modi has announced plans to return to India for the first time in nearly 14 years after securing major relief from the Appellate Tribunal under the Smugglers and Foreign Exchange Manipulators Forfeiture of Property Act in the long running 2009 IPL South Africa FEMA case. Relief for former IPL chairman Lalit Modi. The tribunal partly allowed appeals against a 2018 Enforcement Directorate order that had imposed penalties on the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), Lalit Modi, former BCCI president N Srinivasan, M P Pandove, the State Bank of India and its former chief manager A K Nazeer Khan for alleged violations of the Foreign Exchange Management Act. The Enforcement Directorate had alleged that the BCCI breached FEMA regulations by transferring funds abroad after the 2009 IPL was shifted to South Africa because of the Indian general elections.
